title: PriorityWeightProfile
description: A versioned, owner-authored set of weights used to compute a candidate's recommendationScore. Never edited in place -- a changed weighting creates a new profile with supersedesWeightProfileId pointing at the one it replaces (mirrors RuleVersion's supersession pattern). Component dimensions on the candidate are never collapsed away by this profile -- it only defines how they combine into one sortable, explainable number.

positiveDimensionWeights.description: dimension name -> weight (0-100). Weights across all keys should sum to 100; the scoring code normalizes over only the dimensions actually populated on a given candidate.

penaltyDimensions.description: Names of dimensions that reduce recommendationScore when present (e.g. promotionalContentScore). Never defaulted to 0 when unassessed -- absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.

maxPenaltyDiscount.description: Upper bound on how much penalty dimensions may discount the base score, so recommendationScore never reaches zero purely from penalties.
